violations.reason: PR 1576 issued an 'approve' verdict for PR 1575, which directly contradicts the PR 1574 Acceptance Criteria (requiring actual test coverage without stubbing) and contains unguarded exception swallowing that fakes success. Under Code Guardian rules, this must be a REJECT.

In JwtAuthenticationFilter.doFilterInternal, try/catch blocks swallow real failures from tokenRevocationService.isTokenRevoked, jwtTokenProvider.getUsername, and persistent role resolution, returning plausible-looking success values (e.g., isRevoked = false, or falling back to ROLE_USER) instead of handling the failure.

PR 1575's title claims to 'Fix JwtAuthenticationFilter causal mechanism', but the diff only wraps existing calls in try/catch blocks that swallow exceptions. This merely suppresses the symptom without changing the underlying mechanism that produced the errors.

PR 1577 (Coverage Audit Report: Moodle Integration) returns '{"gaps": []}', falsely claiming 100% coverage of the Moodle integration requirements specified in the client brief, despite the codebase having zero implementation for those requirements.
